name: Takarazuki Lucy
source:
Fashion designer. [url=/c160936]Yuse[/url]'s mother.

She has a cheerful and easygoing personality, and gets along well with everyone. She's open about sex, and she's keeping an eye on what's going on between the protagonist and her daughter, who's into him.

She loves Japanese things, and her eyes especially light up when it comes to ninja.

Although she and [url=/c160966]Kurenai[/url] are rivals on the surface, really they're just friends who love to argue. She's fond of the protagonist, not just because of work.

[Translated from the [url=https://edoire.jp/products/ikunew/chr/12.html]official website[/url]]
